basics.name: Tim Schmolka
basics.label: Hands-on Technical Leader · Payments & Marketplace Systems · Agent-first Development
basics.summary: Hands-on engineering leader with 10+ years in backend development, nearly 8 at Kleinanzeigen, Germany's largest classifieds marketplace (40M+ monthly visitors), the last 5 as engineering manager, often doubling as tech lead. Known for de-risked migrations of checkout-critical systems, resilient event-driven design and cross-team reliability standards.

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
work.position: Engineering Manager, Transactions (Payments · Shipping · Promotions) · Tech Lead since 2025
highlights: Designed the routing engine that ran both payment service providers (PSPs) side by side for a zero-downtime rollout and sunset in the 5-team switch to Adyen (2025–26), delivered on time in 18 months against a consultancy's 3-year estimate, with 100% of checkouts on Adyen 4 weeks after launch; owned the program's operational health (monitoring, incident response, bug triage, tech debt)

Led seller onboarding and identity verification (KYC): mapped Adyen's account and verification states onto Kleinanzeigen's seller UX, moved millions of sellers, and built event-driven PSP account management that stays consistent through failures and retries (outbox, idempotent consumers)

Migrated the legacy promotion engine to Talon.One (promotions platform) in ~3 months as lead developer: ran event-storming to set domain boundaries, wrote the design doc, and de-risked the cut-over with shadow traffic on every checkout and a resilient integration
Moved the team to agent-first development: Claude Code writes the code, engineers own design, test strategy and review, without compromising quality

Scaling agent-first across the Transactions department (5 teams) while keeping the codebase maintainable: proposed a north-star module architecture (DDD context map) for the core payment service, plus guardrails that keep agents within it and surface important design decisions to engineers

Set reliability standards beyond the team: defined the payment service's first service-level objectives (SLOs), wrote the department's incident management standard and a company-wide alerting standard (pending CTO approval), and became co-owner of the company's incident process
Managed up to 9 engineers (trainee to Staff level)

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
highlights: Built the Motors (cars) team, responsible for eight-figure annual revenue (2 internal promotions, 100% retention)

Launched a new revenue stream, now six figures a year, letting private sellers offer their car to dealers via sister marketplace mobile.de: A/B-tested entry points and a gRPC-streaming notification service
Built a Customer Effort Score feedback service adopted by other teams; co-led a trainee program that hired and mentored 15+ career changers

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
work.position: Senior Software Engineer & Tech Lead, Motors & PRO
highlights: Architected and led Motors' extraction from the monolith: hexagonal architecture, own data store, Kafka, AWS via Terraform
Led engineering for PRO, the subscription product for business sellers (new packages and pricing); moved services from Mesos to Kubernetes
Wrote the company-wide architecture decision record (ADR) replacing Hystrix with Resilience4j for fault tolerance

work.name: Kleinanzeigen (formerly eBay Kleinanzeigen)
highlights: Built the services behind business sellers' shop pages (Kafka-fed caches); maintained the shared gRPC library and load balancing across teams

work.name: Mercury.ai
